displayName: EAIC-KR-T3 Control Plane architecture evidence surfaces
priorAbsorption: EAIC-KR-T3 reads these current Control Plane contracts as bounded architecture evidence. The session contract provides policy, task/session identity, and receipt primitives; the provider router provides bounded provider-selection evidence. Neither is promoted to a universal external-agent invocation owner.
nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan only if a later operator-authorized EAIC roadmap changes these source contracts or claims them as implementation evidence.
